final: WITH per_id AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination WHERE ANA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS mean_avg FROM per_id) SELECT per_id.ID, per_id.avg_ana, per_id.avg_ana - overall.mean_avg AS gap_above_mean FROM per_id CROSS JOIN overall WHERE per_id.avg_ana > overall.mean_avg ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
